blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Pages and frames have equal fixed sizes; the page table maps virtual pages to physical frames.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Divide the virtual address by page size for the page number; use remainder as the offset.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A page fault requires a non-resident page to be loaded. Variable-sized segmentation has different fragmentation characteristics.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
